Risk: Violence (ID: granite-violence)
Description: Promoting or describing physical harm to individuals or groups. This includes depictions of assault, self-harm, or creation of a hostile environment through threats or intimidation.
Concern: None
Policy: Self Harm

Axis: Violence (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Violence)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Homicide: Homicide
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#GlorificationOfViolence: Glorification of Violence
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#WeaponsUse: Weapons Use
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Torture: Torture
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#MassViolence: Mass Violence
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#PhysicalAssault: Physical Assault
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AnimalCruelty: Animal Cruelty
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Terrorism: Terrorism

Axis: Threats of Violence (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence)
Roles: instrument
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeathThreat: Death Threat
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Intimidation: Intimidation
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Stalking: Stalking

Axis: Intimidation (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Intimidation)
Roles: agent
Siblings:
